extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to check a company's records and accounts
extra_vocab.note: 文章裡的 outside auditor 是指公司外部的稽核人員，會到倉庫確認庫存紀錄和發票數量是否一致。outside 強調這個人不是公司內部員工，查核結果較客觀。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: auditor 是可數名詞，單數前要加冠詞；因為 auditor 以母音開頭，要用 an auditor，不用 a auditor。

example.en: The auditors will compare our stock records with the supplier invoices.
example.zh: 稽核員會把我們的庫存紀錄和供應商發票做比對。

example.en: We hired an external auditor to review the annual accounts.
example.zh: 我們聘請了外部稽核員來審查年度帳目。

example.en: Our internal auditor found several errors in the expense reports.
example.zh: 我們的內部稽核員在費用報告中發現了幾處錯誤。

example.en: The auditor's report will be sent to the board on Monday.
example.zh: 稽核報告將在星期一送交董事會。

examples.en: The auditor will present her findings at Thursday's board meeting.
examples.zh: 稽核員將在星期四的董事會上報告她的發現。

examples.en: Please give the auditor access to the inventory records by noon.
examples.zh: 請在中午前讓稽核員可以查閱庫存紀錄。

examples.en: The auditor asked why several purchase orders had no approval signature.
examples.zh: 稽核員詢問為什麼有幾張採購單沒有核准簽名。

confusable.diff: accountant 負責記帳、報稅與編製財務報表；auditor 則是事後檢查這些紀錄是否正確。

example.en: Our accountant prepares the tax forms, and the auditor checks them.
example.zh: 我們的會計師準備稅務表格，稽核員負責檢查。

similar.diff: inspector 檢查設備、產品或安全狀況；auditor 檢查的是帳目與紀錄。

example.en: The safety inspector will check the loading dock tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 安全檢查員明天早上會檢查裝卸碼頭。

example.en: The accountant sent us a summary of last month's expenses.
example.zh: 會計師寄給我們上個月的費用摘要。

example.en: An inspector examined each shipment before it left the factory.
example.zh: 檢查員在每批貨離開工廠前都做了檢驗。

derived.link: 詞幹，指查核帳目或紀錄這件事；加 -or 就變成做這件事的人
audit + -ing，把「做稽核」這件事變成名詞，像 accounting、marketing

extra_vocab.en: in large amounts or large quantities
extra_vocab.note: 文章裡的 bulk orders 指一次大量下的訂單，這類訂單通常有折扣，但數量多也容易出現計數錯誤。bulk 在這裡放在名詞前面，當形容詞用。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: bulk 放在名詞前當形容詞時不加 s，如 bulk order；in bulk 是固定用法，bulk 前面不加 a 或 the。

example.en: We save money when we buy copy paper in bulk.
example.zh: 我們整批購買影印紙時可以省錢。

example.en: Ask the supplier whether they offer a bulk discount on cartons.
example.zh: 問問供應商紙箱有沒有大量購買折扣。

example.en: A bulk purchase of labels lowered our unit cost this quarter.
example.zh: 這一季大量採購標籤降低了我們的單位成本。

examples.en: Bulk shipments usually arrive on pallets instead of in single boxes.
examples.zh: 整批貨通常用棧板送達，而不是單獨的箱子。

examples.en: Could you send us a quote for a bulk delivery of folders?
examples.zh: 可以請你報價一批大量的文件夾嗎？

examples.en: The bulk goods are stored at the back of the warehouse.
examples.zh: 大宗貨物存放在倉庫後方。

confusable.diff: bulky 指體積大、笨重（不一定數量多）；bulk 強調數量多。

example.en: The bulky boxes would not fit through the narrow doorway.
example.zh: 那些笨重的箱子過不了狹窄的門口。

similar.diff: wholesale 指把商品賣給零售商的批發方式；bulk 只強調一次買賣的數量大。

example.en: The retailer pays wholesale prices for every large order.
example.zh: 零售商每筆大宗訂單都按批發價付款。

example.en: The quantity on the invoice does not match the delivery note.
example.zh: 發票上的數量和出貨單不符。

example.en: Sales volume rose sharply after the new campaign started.
example.zh: 新活動開始後銷售量大幅上升。

example.en: Customers receive a discount when they pay within ten days.
example.zh: 客戶在十天內付款可享折扣。

derived.link: bulk + -y，有…特性的，像 rainy、sunny，指「有大體積的」

example.en: Bulk orders often qualify for lower prices per carton.
example.zh: 大量訂單通常可享有較低的每箱單價。

example.en: The bulk of our orders arrive in the last week.
example.zh: 我們大部分的訂單都在最後一週進來。

extra_vocab.note: 文章裡用 It is advisable that... 提出正式的建議：新人最好搭配有經驗的同事，貨物簽收前也要對照採購單。語氣比 should 客氣、正式，常見於公告與說明。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: It is advisable that + S + 原形 V（或 should + V），所以文章寫 be paired、be checked，不寫 is paired；建議對象不必指定時，可用 It is advisable to + V。

example.en: It is highly advisable to book hotel rooms before the trade fair.
example.zh: 貿易展之前非常建議先訂好飯店房間。

example.en: It is not advisable to sign the contract without legal review.
example.zh: 沒有經過法務審查就簽約是不明智的。

example.en: It is advisable to back up your files before the system update.
example.zh: 系統更新前最好先備份你的檔案。

examples.en: It is advisable that all visitors register at the front desk.
examples.zh: 所有訪客最好都在櫃檯登記。

examples.en: Is it advisable to ship the order before payment arrives?
examples.zh: 在款項到帳前就出貨是明智的嗎？

examples.en: The manager said it was advisable to wait for more data.
examples.zh: 經理說最好等到有更多數據再決定。

confusable.diff: advice 是名詞，指「建議」；advisable 是形容詞，用來說「做某事是明智的」。
confusable.usage: advice 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不能說 an advice；要說 a piece of advice。

example.en: She gave us useful advice about preparing for the audit.
example.zh: 她針對稽核準備給了我們很有用的建議。

confusable.diff: advisory 指「提供建議的」或「通知、警告」，不是「建議做某事是明智的」。

example.en: The advisory board meets every quarter to review our strategy.
example.zh: 顧問委員會每季開會檢討我們的策略。

similar.diff: recommended 通常是某人或某份指引推薦的做法，常說 be recommended；advisable 強調這樣做是明智的。

example.en: Early registration is recommended for the sales conference.
example.zh: 建議提早報名參加業務會議。

similar.diff: preferable 用來比較兩個選擇，常接 to；advisable 不做比較，只說這樣做明智。

example.en: Email is preferable to phone calls for keeping a record.
example.zh: 要留下紀錄的話，用電子郵件比打電話好。

example.en: Cutting unnecessary costs is a sensible way to protect profits.
example.zh: 削減不必要的成本是保護利潤的合理做法。

example.en: Please wear appropriate shoes when you enter the warehouse.
example.zh: 進入倉庫時請穿著適當的鞋子。

example.en: It is necessary to check every shipment against the order.
example.zh: 每批貨都必須對照訂單檢查。

derived.link: 詞幹；advise + -able，表示「可以被建議的」，像 reasonable、available
advise 的名詞形，字尾 -ise 變 -ice，像動詞 practise 與名詞 practice
advise + -ory，有…性質的，像 mandatory，指「提供建議的」

extra_vocab.en: to pass something around to many people
extra_vocab.note: 文章裡的 will be circulated 是被動語態，意思是修訂後的程序文件會發給所有相關同事傳閱。這是辦公室裡很常見的正式說法，常見於備忘錄和通知。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: circulate 可當及物動詞（circulate a memo），也可當不及物動詞（rumors circulate）；表示「被傳閱」時用 be circulated，後面常接 to 或 among。

example.en: She circulates the weekly report to every department head.
example.zh: 她把每週報告傳給每位部門主管。

example.en: The manager circulated the new safety rules yesterday afternoon.
example.zh: 經理昨天下午把新的安全規定發給大家。

example.en: We are circulating the draft contract to all team members.
example.zh: 我們正在把合約草案發給所有團隊成員。

example.en: She will circulate the memo to all department heads.
example.zh: 她會把備忘錄傳給所有部門主管。

example.en: The new schedule was circulated among all shift supervisors.
example.zh: 新的班表已在所有輪班主管之間傳閱。

example.en: The news circulated widely before the official statement came out.
example.zh: 官方聲明發布前，這個消息就已廣為流傳。

examples.en: Could you circulate this report so everyone can read it?
examples.zh: 你可以把這份報告傳下去讓大家都看到嗎？

examples.en: Open the vents so that air can circulate in the warehouse.
examples.zh: 把通風口打開，讓倉庫裡的空氣流通。

examples.en: A rumor about overtime cuts began to circulate on Monday.
examples.zh: 星期一開始流傳加班被削減的傳聞。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近但意思不同：calculate 是計算，circulate 是傳閱或流通。

example.en: Please calculate the total cost before you circulate the budget.
example.zh: 請先算出總成本，再把預算傳給大家。

similar.diff: distribute 強調把東西分給每個人或每個地方；circulate 強調文件或消息在人與人之間傳閱、流動。

example.en: We will distribute the new forms at the start of training.
example.zh: 我們會在訓練一開始發放新的表格。

similar.diff: hand out 較口語，指親手發給現場的人；circulate 較正式，常用於文件。

example.en: Please hand out the agendas before the meeting begins.
example.zh: 請在會議開始前把議程發給大家。

example.en: The company distributes its products to stores across the country.
example.zh: 這家公司把產品配送到全國各地的商店。

example.en: The news spread quickly through the whole office.
example.zh: 這個消息很快傳遍整個辦公室。

example.en: Please forward this email to everyone on the receiving crew.
example.zh: 請把這封郵件轉寄給收貨組的每個人。

derived.link: circulate 去掉 e + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 decide → decision、create → creation
circul- + -ar，有…性質的，像 regular；繞圈傳閱的東西就是通知單

senses.en: to pass something around to many people

example.en: Please circulate the minutes to everyone who missed the meeting.
example.zh: 請把會議紀錄傳給所有沒參加會議的人。

senses.en: to move around in a system or space
senses.distinguish: 主詞是空氣、水、血液或資金等時，指循環流動。

example.en: Cash must circulate quickly if the business wants to grow.
example.zh: 企業若想成長，資金就必須快速周轉。

senses.en: to be told or passed from person to person
senses.distinguish: 主詞是消息、傳聞或謠言時，指在人群中流傳。

example.en: Stories about the merger have circulated since last spring.
example.zh: 關於合併的傳言從去年春天就開始流傳。

extra_vocab.en: money paid to a worker, often by the hour or week
extra_vocab.note: 文章裡的 the wages for those extra hours 指加班時數的工資。wages 常指按時數或按週計算的薪資，所以和 overtime 搭配很自然。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: wage 指「工資」時常用複數 wages；但 minimum wage、wage increase 等固定搭配用單數。

example.en: The government plans to raise the minimum wage next year.
example.zh: 政府計畫明年調高最低工資。

example.en: Her hourly wage went up after she finished the training.
example.zh: 她完成訓練後，時薪就提高了。

example.en: Workers asked for a wage increase during the contract talks.
example.zh: 員工在合約協商時要求加薪。

example.en: We pay wages every second Friday of the month.
example.zh: 我們每個月的第二個星期五發放工資。

examples.en: The new overtime rule will raise wages for warehouse staff.
examples.zh: 新的加班規定將提高倉庫員工的工資。

examples.en: Labor costs rose because wages in our region have increased.
examples.zh: 勞動成本上升，是因為我們地區的工資調漲了。

examples.en: Please confirm that all wages were paid on time this month.
examples.zh: 請確認本月所有工資都已準時發放。

confusable.diff: fee 是付給專業人士或機構的服務費用；wages 是付給員工的工資。

example.en: The consultant's fee was higher than the workers' wages.
example.zh: 顧問的費用比工人的工資還高。

similar.diff: salary 是月薪或年薪，金額固定，多用於正職與辦公室職務；wages 常按時數或週計算，多用於工人。

example.en: Her annual salary will be reviewed again in January.
example.zh: 她的年薪會在一月再次檢討。

similar.diff: compensation 是整體報酬，包含薪資、獎金與福利，較正式；也可指賠償。

example.en: The compensation package includes bonuses and health insurance.
example.zh: 這份整體報酬方案包含獎金與健康保險。

similar.diff: pay 最口語、涵蓋最廣，可泛指各種薪酬；wages 則特指工資。

example.en: Overtime pay is calculated at one and a half times the normal rate.
example.zh: 加班費以一般費率的一點五倍計算。

example.en: Every employee received a bonus after the successful quarter.
example.zh: 這一季成績優異，每位員工都領到了獎金。

example.en: The staff worked overtime to finish the recount on schedule.
example.zh: 員工加班，才讓重新盤點如期完成。

example.en: The payroll department sends out payslips on the last day.
example.zh: 薪資部門在月底最後一天寄出薪資單。

extra_vocab.en: a person who has just arrived or just joined a group
extra_vocab.note: 文章裡的 every newcomer on the receiving crew 指剛加入收貨組的新員工，和後面的 experienced colleague（有經驗的同事）形成對比。整句的重點是讓新人跟著老手學習，降低出錯機會。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: every 後面接單數可數名詞，所以是 every newcomer，不是 every newcomers；後面的動詞也要配合單數。

example.en: Newcomers should ask questions whenever a procedure is unclear.
example.zh: 遇到不清楚的程序時，新人應該隨時發問。

example.en: We held a lunch to welcome each newcomer to the team.
example.zh: 我們辦了午餐會，歡迎每位加入團隊的新人。

example.en: As a newcomer to the industry, he asked many questions.
example.zh: 身為這個行業的新進者，他問了很多問題。

example.en: She is a relative newcomer to sales but performs very well.
example.zh: 她進入業務領域不久，但表現非常好。

examples.en: Every newcomer must attend the safety briefing on the first day.
examples.zh: 每位新人第一天都必須參加安全說明會。

examples.en: A mentor will guide each newcomer through the first month.
examples.zh: 每位新人在第一個月都會有導師指導。

examples.en: The department hired three newcomers to handle the busy season.
examples.zh: 部門僱用了三位新人來應付旺季。

confusable.diff: latecomer 指晚到的人或較晚加入的人；newcomer 指剛到或剛加入的人，強調「新」。

example.en: The latecomers missed the safety briefing at the start.
example.zh: 遲到的人錯過了一開始的安全說明。

similar.diff: trainee 指正在受訓的人，不一定剛到公司；newcomer 只強調剛加入。

example.en: Each trainee works beside a supervisor for the first week.
example.zh: 每位受訓人員第一週都跟在主管身邊工作。

similar.diff: recruit 指剛被招募進來的新進人員，較強調招聘的過程。

example.en: The new recruits will start work on the first of March.
example.zh: 新進人員將從三月一日開始上班。

similar.diff: newbie 很口語、有時帶點開玩笑，不適合用在正式公告。

example.en: I'm still a newbie, so please explain the process again.
example.zh: 我還是新手，請再說明一次流程。

example.en: My mentor showed me how to check a delivery note.
example.zh: 我的導師教我怎麼核對出貨單。

example.en: A veteran from the shipping team trained the new staff.
example.zh: 出貨組的一位資深人員負責訓練新員工。

example.en: The supervisor signed the form after checking the shipment.
example.zh: 主管檢查完貨物後，在表格上簽了名。
